mechanism.statement: A transition into sustained joint demand for Ethereum execution blockspace and blobspace may represent Ethereum-specific settlement/data-availability demand that is not fully reflected immediately in ETH relative to BTC.
independent_rationale: EIP-1559 burns execution base fees and makes execution demand observable through block gas utilization/base fee.
EIP-4844 created a separate blob fee market for rollup data availability with blobGasUsed and excessBlobGas in execution headers.
This candidate tests persistence and joint L1+L2 settlement demand, not the parent's one-day burn/utilization spike.
mechanism.failure_mode: Joint blockspace-demand state transitions do not precede positive ETHBTC relative returns after costs, or the effect is unstable/concentrated.

material_novelty.old_signal: single-day burn >= prior90 p80 AND utilization >= prior90 median
material_novelty.new_signal: two-day persistent transition into joint high execution-utilization and blob-usage percentile states

signal_contract.aggregation: UTC daily medians from evenly spaced header samples
signal_contract.daily_exec_high: current daily median >= prior-30-day empirical 75th percentile
signal_contract.daily_blob_high: current daily median blobGasUsed >= prior-30-day empirical 75th percentile
signal_contract.transition: joint_high on two consecutive complete UTC days AND at least one of the preceding two complete days was not joint_high
signal_contract.entry: next UTC-day ETHBTC open after second confirming day
